KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. fupi
   C. pana
   D. zito

2. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

3. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

5. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.
   B. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.
   D. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.

6. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. watoto
   C. kitoto
   D. mato

7. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

8. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

9. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — fupi

2. D — Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

3. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

4. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

5. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.

6. B — watoto

7. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

8. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

9. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa.; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadithi; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadithi; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
